scope: Construction of one explicitly selected village gravity sewer network VSN-HDPE-SN8-OD200-160-3200 with 2400 m of OD200 SN8 main, 800 m of OD160 SN8 house-connection laterals, 64 inspection manholes and 120 explicit house connections. Direct survey, trench, bedding, pipe, fittings, manholes, backfill, reinstatement, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved village sewer design, longitudinal profiles, pipe and manhole schedules, house-connection register, geotechnical report, testing laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: pressure sewer, pumping station, treatment plant, septic facility or unrelated stormwater network
trench, bedding, manhole, connection, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from total length, flow or diameter
automatic rock excavation, groundwater dewatering, traffic management or road reinstatement
universal retained spare or supplier-bundle length
